title: SDLC Global Reference v1
description: A globally qualified SDLC reference that identifies a repository and either a task entity or a work-item artifact entity. Task references use the task identifier form; work-item references use a work-item ID, a work-item-relative filename, and an in-file entity selector.
$comment: SdlcReference supports task-global references in the form sdlc://repo/<repository-id>/<TaskIdentifier>#<entity-kind>/<entity-id>, and work-item-global references in the URI-safe form sdlc://repo/<repository-id>/<WorkItemId>#<filename>%23<entity-kind>/<entity-id>. The repository identifier is one percent-encoded URI path segment; %7C separates a task identifier and %23 separates a work-item filename from its in-file selector. The parser must validate percent encoding, canonicalize escapes, and resolve the repository, work item or task, file, and entity; JSON Schema checks only the string shape.

oneOf.description: A globally qualified reference to an entity in a task payload or result.
A globally qualified reference to an entity in a work-item artifact.
